notes.title: 🧊 Cube Crawler – Update EA_B004
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45445582/ea62a3c7b8ced7b79b94118db8c8cb774863ddb5.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello Pilots,[/p][p]it’s time for another update! 🎉 This one is all about comfort, clarity, and style.[/p][p][/p][p]🔧 [b]HUD & Info Menu[/b][/p][p]The HUD is now even more configurable – you decide which ship stats should be displayed.[/p][p]Your settings are saved, so your setup always stays just the way you want it.[/p][p][/p][p][b]The Info Menu now features two brand-new sections:[/b][/p][list][*][p]📊 [b]Stats[/b] – keep track of your most important values. Decide exactly what should be shown during gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]⚡ [b]Active Buffs[/b] – instantly see which effects are currently active and what they mean. No stress – the Info Menu always pauses the game.[/p][/*][/list][p]🗺️ [b]Minimap Improvement:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjustable & saveable minimap size – small & compact or large & detailed, the choice is yours.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked player icon with facing direction – instantly see where you are and where you’re heading.[/p][/*][/list][p]🎵 [b]Main Menu[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fresh new look & feel![/p][/*][*][p]A brand-new main theme sets the perfect sci-fi atmosphere right from the start.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]👉 This update is another step towards clearer information, better overview, and more player comfort.
As always, feedback is welcome – share your impressions here or on Discord![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support and have fun crawling through the cube! 🚀[/p][p]— FreeTimeDevelopment[/p]

notes.title: 🧊 Cube Crawler – The Merchant Update is here!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45445582/3d2a405efdfebbce6fecc9cb1604af46598241df.png"][/img][/p][h3]🔥 New Core Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]Merchant Room[/b] – discover it in your runs and trade with the mysterious terminal[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Category: Special Items[/b] – instant effects that directly impact your run[/p][/*][*][p][b]Merchant Voice Lines[/b] – cold, sarcastic, and eerie (voice generated with AI)[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Tab Menu[/b] – access detailed information at any time about your equipment, buffs, artifacts, stats, and room cards.
→ This way you’ll always know exactly how your items work and can perfectly finalize your builds![/p][/*][*][p][b]French language added[/b] – Cube Crawler is now playable in [b]DE / EN / FR / ES / RU[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Critical hits and armor[/b] are now part of the game, both for the player and the monsters[/p][/*][*][p]Various [b]bugfixes, improvements, and much more...[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]🛠 What’s next?[/h3][p]This is only the beginning. With this update, Cube Crawler officially kicks off its content expansions – and I am already working on the next package with brand-new content.
A rough roadmap will follow soon![/p][p][/p][p]👉 Tell us in the comments: [b]Which builds are you planning to try out?[/b][/p]

notes.title: BIG UPDATE - Trader room, Ui-Info menu, French language, & more ... ( A002 )
notes.content:
[url=https://www.freetimedev.de][img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/841d4c_2b38f2e1e438480f917f6e358079c923~mv2.png[/img][/url]

Fixed:

[list]
[*]Bullet Hit-System improved weakness detection and wrong layers
[*]Particle-System sizes corrected for different sizes
[*]Corrected RU language
[*]Collecting behaviour of gear is now changed and improved to selection system
[*]Correct buff refresh / stack system and behaviour
[*]Nanosurge does not overheal anymore.
[*]Buff triggering is now 100 % precise to trigger time and amount
[*]BurstCell drop chance is now really 17% and not 83% ( :-D )
[*]Player slowed down on moving stairs up
[*]Hotkey rebinding is now working again and saves / loads
[*]Gear is not collectable anymore if game is paused
[*]Gear is now protected with leave room protection
[*]Gear Hud animations corrected and smoothed
[*]Smaller gameplay fixes and improvements for controlling
[*]Smaller visual fixes and performance improvements
[/list]

Added:

[list]
[*]Trading Room is now available! Buy Gear, Items or Special Items with Cube Coins
[*]Trader (terminal) has voice lines in all languages for ambient [voice lines created with AI]
[*]French language fully added to the game
[*]A single buff can now have stacks, small number on HUD icon
[*]Multiple buffs can now stacked (different handled but nice ui), small number on HUD icon
[*]Every Gear can now have different rarities and RANDOM values
[*]NEW Ui-Info Menu with 5 categories. You can now pause the game with tah Ui-Info button to view ALL of your stuff in detail: Gear, Buffs, Artifacts, Stats and Roomcards
[*]First special item for trader: Critical Overdrive (100% crit chance for next 5 monster rooms)
[*]NEW Gear Swap/Display visuals
[*]Gear can now be inspected and compared on collecting via gear swap display
[*]Mouse Support for aiming and controlling. The mouse can now also be used as input (EXCEPT UI !!!)
[*]Collecting effect for items, gear, ...
[*]Ground slime now applies slow effect to player
[*]Most menus can now also be closed with Esc even if the Esc button is not the hotkey for it
[*]Player now has Crit Chance and Crit Damage as NEW properties
[*]Player now has Armor Chance and Armor as NEW properties
[*]Monsters now has Crit Chance and Crit Damage as NEW properties
[*]Monsters now has Armor Chance and Armor as NEW properties
[*]New sounds / music for new events / effects stuff
[/list]

Changed:

[list]
[*]Monster Actions now can have cooldown -> example: Ionis (drone) now does not evade all the time
[*]Added Base Damage of BurstCell because of drop chance fix
[*]GameTime is now paused on Video Sequences -> fair for player watching the videos
[*]Ship Displays now changed some shown properties to most relevant such as armor, crit, ...
[*]Hide some properties from ship display that are all similar and first not relevant to player
[*]In future: The HUD stats can be customized by player. Decide what you want to see always
[/list]
